issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted, 2026-08-12) specifies a third dependency kind `verifies` so authors can declare a check relationship, plus an advisory structural diagnosis of inverted verification gates (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead). It explicitly deferred the work: "Specified as post-0.1 item R025; §3.4's two-kind set is unchanged for 0.1" — the project is now post-0.1 (v0.2.x), yet no open bead carries R025 or the `verifies` edge. Work to close the gap: extend the dependency schema, `bead dep` CLI, audit events, and checkpoint serialization for the new edge kind; define its interaction with §3.4 cycle rejection (a `verifies` edge must not create blocks-semantics cycles); surface the inversion diagnosis advisory-only (report, never reject at insert, never infer from titles) via `bead doctor`; update `bead schema explain` field-guide output, help snapshots, and the relevant spec; add conformance and concurrency tests per AGENTS.md ("never claim compatibility without passing the corresponding conformance suite").

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Implement the R025 verifies dependency kind with structural inversion diagnosis (ADR-001)
